object: A solid red heart shape with a thick black outline and a thin white inner border is centered in the image.
Two identical wings extend upward and outward from either side of the heart, each composed of layered feather-like segments in light blue and white, outlined in black.
Each wing contains approximately seven visible primary feather segments, tapering toward the tips, with darker blue shading along inner edges.
The uppermost parts of the wings curve inward to meet above the heart, forming a U-shaped negative space between them.
A faint light-blue drop shadow surrounds the entire composition, separating it visually from the white background.
